about_the_game:
Dodge to the Beat!

Beat Dodger is a Rhythm game that combines flying through obstacles, and tapping to the beat while jamming to tunes! Anyone can do it! All you have to do is follow 2 simple steps:

Step 1: Tap to the beat!

Obstacles fly towards you, when the obstacles reach about the size of the white ring, just Hit the Beat. Be careful though! Too early or too late, and it will count as a missed beat.

Step 2: Dodge the obstacles!

While tapping to the beat, fly up, down, diagonally, or sideways to soar through openings in the obstacles or catch collectibles and get the highest score! If you think you might not make it, use the Dash to gain a sudden boost of speed!

That's it! Easy to pick up, and hard to master, hope you enjoy your time playing Beat Dodger!

FEATURES:

  • Learn the rhythm! Just like songs, all obstacles follow a pattern the same way you can learn a song by ear, you can learn the route by sight!

  • Chill Mode! Some people play games to just chill~ Enjoy Chill Mode where you can play the game worry free and just vibe to the music.

  • Colorblind mode! We know that some shades and colors will make it difficult for some of our players to enjoy the game. Introducing Colorblind Mode where we use colorblind friendly palettes so our colorblind friends can enjoy! 

  • Free Future Content! Enjoy new tracks, and levels when we develop free futures patches.

Beat Dodger uses flashing lights and colors. Please use caution if you or people around you experiences epilepsy or similar conditions.

short_description: Beat Dodger is a Rhythm game on rails where you need to dodge obstacles and stay on beat! With different obstacle-types, soar, dodge, and tap on beat across various worlds through their music! Go for the highest score in brutal difficulties or relax without worrying about score!
